dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows numbers that change — counts, prices, scores, the figures of a dashboard — and wants every such change seen the same way: which digits changed and which way, at one pace, in the product's one manner of moving a digit.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a number ticker reads: how a digit changes (slide, blur, blur-slide or flip), how long a change takes and its curve, the delay from one digit place to the next, the cross-fade under reduced motion, and the blur's radius and the blur-slide's distance. It has no font, size or color of its own: it is drawn in the text style of where it stands.
rules: Place it in text: it takes the font, size, color and direction of where it stands, and draws its digits in tabular figures.
Leave live off for a figure that is not the point of the moment; set it polite only for a number a person waits for. It is told once a change settles, never in between.
It has no colors for a rise or a fall: what a change means is the product's to say, beside the number (a tag, a word).
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; one product moves its numbers one way.

animation.$description: How a digit changes: slide (its column moves through the window), blur, blur-slide or flip (a split-flap board). The animation prop's auto reads it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

duration.$description: How long one change takes: the digits and the width move together, so it is the role of a large change of size.

easing.$description: The curve of the digits' and the width's motion.

stagger.$description: How much later each digit place starts than the one before it, from the most significant to the least. Shorter than sys.motion.duration.stagger, which spaces the items of a list: the digits of one number would lag half a second behind over six places.

reduced-duration.$description: The cross-fade from the old number to the new one while motion is reduced.

radius.$description: How blurred a digit is at the far end of a blur or blur-slide change: the old one blurs to it as it fades out, the new one sharpens from it as it fades in.

distance.$description: How far a digit moves out and in during a blur-slide change, in the direction a slide would move it.
